note_on_revision: CODEX/SUBAGENT_BRIEF: gate against THIS recorded revision, not live HEAD. Sibling experiments land continuously; HEAD moving is not contamination. Validity is decided by the authored-blob hashes below.

clean_room.inputs_inspected: only MSL we authored (kernels/*.metal) and the AGX bytes the public Metal runtime produced from it

archive_reuse_rule: Both gated runs use these EXACT archive files. A run whose archive hash differs is INVALID and is retained, not repaired.

k_line3.oracle: o[i] = (((a[i]*3 + i*7 + 11) mod 2^32) XOR 0x13579BDF) + 0x2468ACE0 mod 2^32, i in 0..31; o[64+i] = 0xA5A50000+i (sentinel); o[32..63] and o[96..127] must remain 0xDEADBEEF poison

c_depth.oracle: DEPTH(x,y) = interpolated v0; PIX0.r(x,y) = 0.5 + 0.25*v0 -> DEPTH == (PIX0.r-0.5)*4 exactly, at three probe pixels with three DISTINCT values

c_depth2.role: ADVERSARIAL SECOND CARRIER for arm A (Phase 5): depth is a DECREASING function of a DIFFERENT varying, colour carries a THIRD varying, two varyings are interpolated instead of one.

readback_poison: 0xDEADBEEF, applied by BOTH runners to every read-back surface before every dispatch

raw_record_schema.file: raw/<run_id>/sweep.jsonl (one JSON object per case, appended and flushed immediately)
raw_record_schema.note: AMENDED before the amendment's first GATED dispatch (only raw/g17p_confsmoke, retained, ran before this): render cases now also record the EXACT number of differing pixels on each surface and a value histogram, so a semantic claim quotes numerators rather than a hash inequality. The full baseline surfaces are retained once per run.

watchdog: runner199.py: ONE pump thread per child tagged by owner (DEF-0178-1). A timeout restarts the child and is recorded as hang; a truncated/unparseable response is recorded MALFORMED = measurement_failed and is EXCLUDED from agreement and from values_dispatched.

known_hazards_excluded: insert the 2-byte word 01 00 at any k_line boundary -- 5/5 GPU HANGS in prefreeze pilot02; excluded from the frozen matrix and reported as a hazard finding
frame_marker_compact b1 in {3,7} -- EXP-0172 recorded device hangs on four of five carriers; excluded from the 2-byte-form subset
hang_policy.on_budget_exceeded: STOP that arm, mark it PARTIAL, record it

gate.movement_rule: moved >= 2.0 * disagree AND moved > 0  (NOT max(disagree,1) -- see FIELD-SWEEP-PROTOCOL sec.5b: the max() form cannot promote a width-1 field by arithmetic)
gate.health_check_rule: an unspliced request must reproduce the frozen baseline; a divergence marks every case after it CONTAMINATED

amends: CAPTURE_CONTRACT.json (retained unchanged); runs g17p_run01*/g17p_run02*/smoke01/prefreeze are RETAINED as DISCOVERY and are not re-run
normative_source: RE_EXPERIMENT_PROCESS_CORRECTIONS.md (user-added 2026-08-30); overrides the original gates where they conflict
harness_change: crun199.m and gfrun5.m gain --ledger <off>:<len>, which prints `ACTUAL <off> <hex>` from the spliced file RE-READ FROM DISK, i.e. the exact bytes handed to newLibraryWithURL:. Nothing else changed; every pre-existing response line is produced under identical conditions.

gate_A_ledger.assertion: req_value == value decoded independently from ACTUAL bytes AND actual_bytes[0:len(req_bytes)] == req_bytes

E: none -- semantics declared unknown in advance; sem_checked == 0

gate_E_confirmation.why: eight or nine agents share this device by standing policy; there is no lease and FIELD-SWEEP-PROTOCOL sec.7 forbids reinstating one
gate_E_confirmation.substitute: concurrency MEASURED into raw/<run>/concurrency.jsonl, and every non-ok case adjudicated OFFLINE from the 0xDEADBEEF poison and the independent sentinels (EXP-0160 filter)

baseline_rule: A per-carrier baseline that is not `ok` is a MEASUREMENT FAILURE on a shared device, never a hardware result: it is retried up to 6 times and, if still not clean, the run ABORTS. The partial capture is RETAINED under its own id and the replacement is captured under a NEW id (g17p_conf02 aborted this way; g17p_conf03 replaces it).
